stem: True or False: The widespread papules and itching associated with scabies are always located exactly where the mites are burrowing.
explanation: There may only be a dozen mites on the entire body, while the itchy red papules represent a generalized immune sensitivity reaction to the infestation.
rationale: Recall if the number of mites usually matches the number of itchy bumps on the skin.

optionExplanations.A: Most of the rash is actually a hypersensitivity reaction to the mite's presence, rather than the physical location of the mites themselves.
optionExplanations.B: There may only be a dozen mites on the entire body, while the itchy red papules represent a generalized immune sensitivity reaction to the infestation.
